table.name: Has_Pet
table.purpose: Junction/ownership table linking students to their pets; each row records that a student owns a particular pet. Composite key of (StuID, PetID).

PetID.name: PetID
PetID.description: Identifier of the pet, referencing Pets.PetID (e.g. 2001=cat, 2002/2003=dog). Each pet appears once, so ownership is one student per pet.

StuID.name: StuID
StuID.description: Identifier of the student who owns the pet, referencing Student.StuID. A student can own multiple pets (student 1002 owns two).

table.name: Pets
table.purpose: A lookup/entity table of pets, each row describing one pet (type, age, weight). Linked to students via the Has_Pet junction table.

PetID.name: PetID
PetID.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each pet.

PetType.name: PetType
PetType.description: Species/type of the pet, e.g. 'dog' or 'cat'.

pet_age.name: pet_age
pet_age.description: Age of the pet, most likely in whole years (values 1-3); unit not confirmed by joins.

weight.name: weight
weight.description: Weight of the pet, plausibly in kilograms (values 9.3-13.4); unit not confirmed.

table.name: Student
table.purpose: One row per student: identity, demographics, major, advisor, and home city. Referenced by Has_Pet, which links students to their pets in the Pets table.

Advisor.name: advisor_id
Advisor.description: Identifier of the student's advisor (likely a faculty/staff ID). No join detected to any table in this database, so the referenced table is not present; the ID itself is unresolved beyond being an advisor identifier.

Age.name: age
Age.description: Student's age in years (range 16-27, mostly 17-21, consistent with college students).

Major.name: major_code
Major.description: Numeric code for the student's major/degree program (values like 600, 550, 540, 520, 100, 50). No lookup table or join exists in this database, so the meaning of individual codes is unresolved; it is plausibly a department or major code.

StuID.name: student_id
StuID.description: Primary key: unique student ID (1001-1035). Referenced by Has_Pet.StuID to link students to pets.

city_code.name: city_code
city_code.description: Three-letter code for the student's home city: BAL (Baltimore), PIT (Pittsburgh), NYC (New York), PHL (Philadelphia), CHI (Chicago), HKG (Hong Kong), ATL (Atlanta), HOU (Houston), etc. No lookup table present, so codes are inferred from common airport/city abbreviations.
